item.title: Plane wreckage removed from north Phoenix home following crash
item.description: One day after a small plane crashed into a north Phoenix home just minutes after takeoff, we are hearing air traffic control audio from the moments leading up to the crash.The crash happened at around 7:20 a.m. on March 4 near Cave Creek Road and Deer Valley Drive.Phoenix Fire Capt. Todd Keller says the plane took off from nearby Deer Valley Airport and was heading west.
